title: MINION: A Low-Cost Autonomous Lagrangian Platform for Ocean Observations
summary: MINION is a compact, autonomous float that collects ocean observations as it drifts with the surrounding water.
coverAlt: MINION underwater with a squid beside the float

items.label: Low-cost:
items.text: The float is compact and inexpensive, making it practical to deploy multiple units.

items.label: Autonomous:
items.text: MINION integrates multiple sensors, data acquisition, and communications and operates autonomously.

items.label: Lagrangian:
items.text: MINION drifts with the surrounding water and makes observations along its path.
